theory.environment_matrix: E_i in R^(4x9), rows=(delta_m,delta_r,v_m,v_r) n=2 coefficient vectors
theory.topographic_matrix: X(z) in R^(2x9), rows=(q2/Pi2-equivalent temporal components across the 9 spatial coefficients)
theory.universal_single_profile_sufficient_cond: rank(E_i)<=1, i.e. all environmental n=2 coefficient vectors are proportional to one common spatial profile
theory.important_distinction: orientation may be inherited from environmental n=2 coefficients; isotropic temporal evolution cannot create an axis from an isotropic state

exact_n2_tensor_projection.fourth_moment: integral X_A X_B X_C X_D dOmega = (pi^2/12)(delta_AB delta_CD + delta_AC delta_BD + delta_AD delta_BC)
exact_n2_tensor_projection.n2_projection_tensor: A_AB[F] = (6/pi^2) integral F(X) (X_A X_B - delta_AB/4) dOmega_3

multi_epoch_temporal_injectivity_diagnos.interpretation: Across multiple epochs the environmental inputs are temporally distinguishable. The matter-only (delta_m,v_m) block is robustly rank 2, so a redshift-persistent single spatial profile requires the density and velocity n=2 spatial coefficients to be aligned (or a separately derived reduction/cancellation).

independent_low_z_environment_proxy_diag.purpose: diagnostic only; these low-z proxies are NOT the z=2.1 environmental initial state and are not theory-selection inputs
independent_low_z_environment_proxy_diag.interpretation: The retained local density and velocity directional proxies are separated by about 62 deg and are therefore not an empirical rank-1 pair. Individual density shells are also strongly multi-directional. This favors retaining a coupled/multi-profile environmental description unless a physical reduction is derived. It does NOT determine the high-z initial state or establish BHSM.

next_exact_test.name: ENVIRONMENTAL_SPATIAL_PROVENANCE_GATE_S0
next_exact_test.target: project independently specified density and velocity fields onto the complete n=2 trace-free tensor basis, with survey/window correction, before comparison to SN
steps: For each scalar environmental field F_alpha on S3, form A_AB^(alpha)=(6/pi^2) integral F_alpha(X)(X_A X_B-delta_AB/4)dOmega.
For discrete/partial surveys, construct and invert/regularize the n=2 window coupling matrix rather than treating raw sums as full-sky coefficients.
Vectorize the nine independent trace-free coefficients into E_i (4x9).
Report SVD/rank of E_i, and separately of the pure A4i dipole submatrix (4x3).
Propagate with frozen U_XE(z) without observational retuning.
Freeze the predicted spatial coefficient trajectory and only then compare axes/multipoles to SN or other observables.

claim_boundary: The temporal coupled-state rank result is action-native R1 and does not determine environmental initial conditions.
The exact n=2 tensor projection formula is geometry; applying it to a catalog requires a declared radial selection and window correction.
Low-z 2MRS density/velocity directions are independent environmental diagnostics, not the z=2.1 initial state.
No SN axis/amplitude may be used to select the environmental field, its rank, or its relative normalization.
No manuscript scientific conclusion is changed by this provenance note alone.
